object.name: evi_rampsmoothupdate
object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP <o>rampsmooth~</o> in gen abstraction form
object.description: evi_rampsmoothupdate is identical to an MSP <o>rampsmooth~</o> where it's ramp inlets are fed by integers (ramp times continuously update regardless of if input value changes) providing exact ramps in the given destination times. The algorithm is slightly different to account for efficiency in the gen~ domain, but it seems to work well. Based on the gen~ example by Maurizio Giri and Graham Wakefield.

inlets.name: input
inlets.digest: Input value to be smoothly ramped.

inlets.name: ramp
inlets.digest: Amount of time the value takes to reach it's up destination. Input continuously updates whenever changed. evi_rampsmoothupdate reaches it's up destination exactly in this time.

inlets.name: ramp
inlets.digest: Amount of time the value takes to reach it's down destination. Input continuously updates whenever changed. evi_rampsmoothupdate reaches it's down destination exactly in this time.

outlets.name: exact
outlets.digest: Smoothed output ramp, or target value if envelope is complete.

outlets.digestauto: When Env Reaches Destination (0 During Env)
outlets.digest: 1 When Envelope Reaches Destination (0 During Envelope).
